game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform glyph tablets.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform glyph tablets. Each round, a new glyph tablets challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of glyph tablets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pillar Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 220 within 39 seconds.
